purpose: LGA-level covariates that exist in places with no sampled household; no model fitted

adm2.note: the brief said 1,299 polygons; the simplified ADM2 file actually holds 774 (one per LGA), same file scripts/lga_assign.R uses

clusters.note: LGA ids and coordinates from scripts/lga_assign.R; shapeID of the ADM2 file, not re-derived here

units.Aridity_2020: aridity index, low = arid (DHS Geospatial Covariate Manual: ratio of annual precipitation to annual potential evapotranspiration)
units.Nightlights_Composite: nighttime luminosity, VIIRS composite (radiance; right-skewed, min 0)
units.Travel_Times: minutes to reach a high-density urban centre
units.Livestock_Cattle: cattle density (GLW v2 modelled heads per km2)
units.Malaria_Incidence_2020: clinical Plasmodium falciparum cases per person

geometry.centroid_method: planar centroid in EPSG:6933, transformed back to EPSG:4326
geometry.polygons_not_duplicated: geometry for each lga_id stays in the ADM2 geojson; this table carries area and centroid only

interpolation.method: inverse-distance weighting over the k nearest clusters

cross_validation.scheme: 5-fold over the 1380 clusters; interpolation rebuilt from the 4/5 held in, prediction made at each held-out cluster's own coordinates
cross_validation.external_validity_note: The CV predicts at a held-out cluster, whose own LGA is sampled by construction. 123 LGAs have no cluster at all and their nearest cluster is typically farther away than a held-out cluster's nearest training cluster, so the CV understates the error at the places the table exists to serve.
cross_validation.interpretation: rmse_over_sd near 1 means the interpolation carries no spatial information; near 0 means it is nearly exact

selection_rule.step2: then drop if |r| > 0.80 on the 774 LGA values with a covariate already kept, earlier in the fixed order wins
selection_rule.step3: then keep at most 6, population density first if it survives

holdout_zone_test.interpretation: An LGA is unaffected exactly when its three nearest clusters all lie outside the excluded zone; with squared-exponential-free IDW that is deterministic, so any exception is a numerical tie and is counted above.

limitations: Covariates are interpolated from the DHS cluster coordinates, which are displaced (up to 2 km urban, 5 km rural, 1% of rural up to 10 km). The surfaces are coarse relative to that displacement for some variables, so the interpolation error measured here includes displacement error.

The interpolation is only as good as the surface's spatial smoothness. Where rmse_over_sd is high the number exists for every LGA but carries little information, and entering it in a model adds a column, not knowledge.

Cluster sampling is itself spatially clustered inside states; the CV folds hold out clusters at random, so the measured error is an optimistic bound for a place far from any cluster (the unsampled LGAs).

Area and density use geoBoundaries simplified polygons, not the official LGA cadastre; coastal and riverine LGAs include water in their polygon, so density is population per polygon km2, not per habitable km2.
Travel_Times and Nightlights_Composite are heavy-tailed and enter as raw values; no transform is applied here because transforming is a modelling choice, not a data-collection one.
Population comes from COD-PS 2020 projections of the 2006 census, not from the DHS. Bakassi has no COD-PS denominator and its density is NA, never zero.
